answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the crystal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the anchor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
